texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: S. D. Goitein, "Prayers from the Geniza for Fatimid Caliphs, the Head of the Jerusalem Yeshiva, the Jewish Community and the Local Congregation," in Studies in Judaica, Karaitica and Islamica, Presented to Leon Nemoy on his Eightieth Birthday (Ramat Gan: Bar-Ilan University Press, 1982).
texts.html: (May) the prayer of God and His blessings, His ever-growing benefactions, His greetings and call of Peace (be) upon our lord and master, the Imām al-Ḥāfiẓ li-dīn Allāh, the Commander of the Faithful.
